notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No agent model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.
instances null = the single shipped task w1_t2. 4 arms x 8 reps = 32 cells, the pre-registered design (paper Section 6).
Every arm needs bash (the agent scripts market_model.xlsx with python3/openpyxl), so every arm is min_isolation=container; host-unsafe is non-conforming.

max_turns is the primary budget, set generously so that it is not the binding constraint. The paper ran on a dollar budget ($8 --max-budget-usd) and a 3600 s timeout; both are kept here as rails (a trial that hits one is scored, never retried).
No query budget on qa_check: the paper enforced none.
Judge: claude-sonnet-4-6 x 3 passes (the paper's judge), run after the agents with `dbwm eval4-judge --run DIR`; panel majority with min_valid 2, null votes never count as fails.

The deterministic checker needs the 'formulas' package (pip install 'diff-bwm-1[recalc]') to see computed outputs of openpyxl-written workbooks; without it the v1 ruleset marks such workbooks unscorable.
